Video Editor with AI Features — Initial Release

- Quickly turn raw screen recordings into polished 1080p clips by simply describing your desired edits.
- Seamless cloud-based AI video editing with no local installation or export setup required.
- Automatic connection and authentication, including free 7-day token for new users.
- Supports smart prompt routing for actions like export, credits, upload, and state queries.
- Handles common editing needs: cutting pauses, adding music, generating captions, text overlays, and more.
- Extensive export format support (mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, png, audio formats).
- Clear inline error handling, session management, and helpful workflow tips.
